name.ja: BB戦士361 于禁ガンダム

en: • The 11th installment of the Sangokuden Gaiden introduces Cao Cao's military commander "Ukin". • Reproduce 3 types of weapons by changing the tip to any equipment Molded product x 4, foil seal x 1, assembly manual x 1
